result.title: Infer3D: Inverse Generative Modeling Enables Robust 3D Reconstruction
result.comment: 23 pages, 12 figures, 15 tables. Includes references and appendices. Project page: https://amanikiruga.github.io/infer3d-site/
result.summary: Humans can understand the 3D structure of scenes even from highly unfamiliar or extreme viewpoints. Cognitive science suggests this generalization stems from a top-down generative inference strategy. In contrast, state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction neural networks typically rely on amortized, feedforward inference. While fast, this pattern-matching approach degrades when faced with out-of-distribution (OOD) scene conditions unseen during training. Inspired by the generative nature of human vision, we propose Infer3D, an inverse generative modeling framework that recovers the latent variables of a generative model to best match the monocular input. To prevent degenerate flat outputs, we couple the generative image prior with a frozen 3D lifting network that constrains the optimization space to a valid, multi-view-consistent 3D manifold. Across a variety of controlled synthetic and real-world tasks, Infer3D demonstrates superior OOD reconstruction accuracy compared to feedforward networks trained on equal or larger datasets. Furthermore, mirroring how human perception requires more time to process confusing stimuli, we introduce an adaptive inference strategy that expends more test-time compute on ambiguous OOD examples while efficiently routing in-distribution inputs. Project website: https://amanikiruga.github.io/infer3d-site/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Infer3D，通过反演生成模型的潜变量使其匹配单目输入，并用冻结的 3D 上采样网络约束优化空间，以提升分布外场景的 3D 重建；同时引入按样本歧义程度分配测试时计算的自适应推理策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其依据输入不确定性路由并增配测试时计算的机制，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与动态计算预算提供参照；潜变量反演优化过程也可供核查 latent 状态是否承载必要几何证据。
